name: douyin-send-message
doc: send one direct message to a target user. Evidence: IPC controller.controller.douyin.sendMessageV2 (chunk 19) carries web_id + ms4 (sec_uid); secondMessageContent + 'ms 后发送第二条消息' prove a two-message flow with a delay; send_count + msgTimeLoad:15000 prove per-account send caps and timing. The exact HTTP path is reconstructed from the documented imapi /v1/message/ namespace (3 sibling endpoints evidenced in docs/api-formats-douyin.md 7.6) since the obfuscated main.js constructs the URL dynamically and it is not directly readable.
